items: 🔹 Powerful 8th Gen Intel i7 Performance – Equipped with an Intel Core i7-8665U processor, this Dell 5300 2-in-1 delivers fast, responsive performance ideal for business, multitasking, and everyday computing needs.

🔹 Premium Features & Modern OS – Includes a backlit keyboard, Wi-Fi, USB-C, HDMI, and Windows 11 Pro for advanced security and professional tools. Perfect for remote work, hybrid offices, students, and travelers.
